subject: How to use dropdown menu to upload files in shiny

messages.author: 862dcfdada8cc0b2
messages.subject: How to use dropdown menu to upload files in shiny
parts:
I have a shinny application and have a list of csv files in my shinny application folder. I want to make appear all these files in the drop down menu and select one to upload.



UI.r :
filenames <- list.files(pattern="\\.csv$")
selectInput(inputId = "dataset",
                  label = "Choose platform annotation file",
                  filenames),


Server.r :

inputdata <- reactive({
    switch(input$dataset,
          "file" = filenames)
  })
 
    output$annotation <- renderDataTable({
        inputdata())
   })

I am not sure whether my way of doing is correct. I am not able to upload a file from drop down. Help appreciated.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How to use dropdown menu to upload files in shiny
parts:
inputdata <- reactive({
    switch(input$dataset,
          "file" = filenames)
  })

should just be:

inputdata <- reactive({
  if (grepl("[/\\\\]", input$dataset)) {
    stop("Invalid dataset")
  }
  read.csv(file.path("data", input$dataset))
})

This assumes that your CSV files are in a "data" subdirectory of your app, which I highly recommend. Also note that I ensure input$dataset doesn't include / or \ character, using grepl. This is because a hacker could put whatever value into input$dataset, such as a path that starts with "../../" or whatever; by ensuring that no path separators are in the input, you should be safe to open whatever's in the data directory by that name.
